title: What's New:Drill-Back and Dynamic Dimension Name Support in Power BI Apps for Business Central(2025)

chapters.title: Introduction to drill-back and dynamic dimension names
Understanding drill-back and dimension naming concepts
Dynamic dimension naming in Power BI desktop
Adding shortcut dimensions and refreshing in Power BI

features.name: Drill-back from Power BI to Business Central
features.description: Allows users to click on a number in a Power BI report to open Business Central in a new tab and view all transactions behind that number, enabling deeper investigation of report values.

features.name: Dynamic dimension naming in Power BI apps
features.description: Loads dimension names and proper fields from Business Central dimensions into Power BI reports, allowing filters to display actual dimension names instead of just codes. Supports global dimensions and shortcut dimensions.
caveats: Only supports global dimensions 1-3 in previous versions, now supports shortcut dimensions as well

features.name: Analysis mode scroll-to-column feature
features.description: A new feature in version 27 that allows users to search for a column and right-click to scroll it into view in analysis mode within a Business Central list.

features.name: Dimension sets table in Power BI
features.description: A new table in Power BI that automatically loads dimension names and values from Business Central, enabling dynamic filtering on dimension names instead of codes.
caveats: Requires schema and data refresh to pick up changes made in Business Central
